form.lineQuestion: How did you perceive the referees' consistency in applying the rules?
form.lineScale: 1 = expected standard met in less than 10 % of situations · 10 = met in more than 95 % of situations
form.communicationQuestion: How did you perceive the referees' communication with the team?
form.communicationScale: 1 = players were ignored · 10 = approachable and proactive towards every team member
form.generalPlaceholder: Further factual comments (optional, also about this feedback form)

team.title: Referee feedback
team.intro: Submit your teams' feedback on the referee pair here. Feedback is mandatory for every game and can be submitted only once per team. It becomes available as soon as the game report is closed and should be submitted within 24 hours after that. Please keep your feedback factual; feedback that is not objective will be deleted without notice.
team.contactHint: Submit the feedback yourself or let the team captain do it. Whoever is entered here receives an email with a personal link once the game report is closed, and needs no user account for it. The setting applies to the whole team: all team managers of this team see and edit the same entry. You can still submit the feedback yourself at any time.
team.contactEmailLabel: Email address (leave empty if you want to submit it yourself)
team.preferCaptain: Prefer to contact the captain of the respective game
team.preferCaptainHint: Only applies if a captain is marked in the game report and an email address is stored on the player profile. Otherwise the address entered above is used.
team.empty: There are currently no games awaiting referee feedback.
